title: calendars-server never sets CalendarEvent isOrigin; calendarIds not enforced on create
description: calendars draft-33 ~1482: isOrigin and calendarIds MUST be present in /get. isOrigin is server-set but nothing in crate-jmap-calendars-server/src sets is_origin; calendarIds should be required at create. Split from JMAP-dqg1 (type crate can't invent a default).
close_reason: isOrigin computed on create/copy/organizer change; client isOrigin patch rejected; calendarIds non-empty enforced on create/copy/update. 8 tests.
